supersedes_for_execution.reason: Section 8 proposed 3 policies x (7x30 + 3x20) = 810 when the protocol defined exactly three policies in section 4: FIXED, REACTIVE, PREDICTIVE. STUDY3_DESIGN.json later grew to four policies by adding ROBUST_FUSION, which is why verify_design.py computes 840+240=1080. The count conflict is documentation drift, not an arithmetic error.
supersedes_for_execution.resolution: Three policies are executed, and the arithmetic returns to the original 810. The three are FIXED (fixed_155), DEPLOYMENT_FIXED and REACTIVE. PREDICTIVE and ROBUST_FUSION are excluded on recorded development null findings, not on convenience; see STUDY3_DEVELOPMENT_NULL_FINDINGS.md.

primary_comparison: reactive_minus_fixed_155 paired within family and seed
supporting_comparison: reactive_minus_deployment_fixed paired within family and seed
immutability: Results are reported regardless of direction. No threshold, family, metric, comparator or sample count changes after inspection.

environment_pin.note: The P5-v4 front end requires cv2.AKAZE_create. OpenCV 5.x removes it from the base package; under such an interpreter the localizer raises AttributeError and the run fails loudly rather than degrading silently. Held-out execution must use an AKAZE-capable OpenCV.
